description: x402 Listing Check: Pre-listing check: is my endpoint payable by a default x402 client? Validates the 402 shape: fetch it, read the challenge, verify accepts[] is complete (scheme, network, asset, amount, payTo), check the example for placeholders, measure it against the 8,190 B edge limit. Returns READY / NEEDS_FIX / NOT_X402 / UNREACHABLE with a fix per finding. Use it to check an x402 endpoint before paying, or when a buyer says your endpoint does not work.
name: x402-listing-check
